### Momentus Technologies Achieves ISO/IEC 42001 Certification

Published September 15, 2026

We are proud to announce that Momentus Technologies has successfully achieved ISO/IEC 42001:2023 certification, the internationally recognized standard for Artificial Intelligence Management Systems (AIMS).

Achieving this certification validates that Momentus has implemented a structured approach to managing AI-related risks, maintaining accountability, protecting customer information, and ensuring responsible AI practices across our products and services. This certification demonstrates our commitment to developing, governing, and managing AI responsibly, securely, and transparently.

This accomplishment builds upon our existing security and compliance programs and reflects the hard work and collaboration of teams across the organization. It reinforces our commitment to providing innovative technology solutions while maintaining the highest standards of trust, governance, and operational excellence.

The official Certificate of Registration is now available for download on the Resources page of the Trust Center.

Read moreRead more about Momentus Technologies Achieves ISO/IEC 42001 Certification

### New SOC 2 Type 2 Report Now Available in the Trust Center

Published February 18, 2026

We’re pleased to announce that our latest SOC 2 Type 2 report is now available for download in the Trust Center.

This new report is dated February 14, 2026, and covers a yearlong observation period from October 16, 2024 through October 16, 2025.

The successful completion of this audit reflects our continued commitment to maintaining strong security, availability, and confidentiality controls. We encourage customers and partners to visit the Trust Center to access the updated report.

If you have any questions, please reach out to our team for assistance.
